'proportional' alloca le unità in propor: 'proportional' allocates units in proportion to stratum size (n_j = N_j · n/N). 'optimal' allocates also in proportion to within-stratum variability σ_j, estimated on the auxiliary variable (Neyman allocation).
'variances': inserire la varianza dello: 'variances': enter the estimator variance under the complex design and under the reference SRS; the module computes Deff as their ratio. 'formula': uses an analytical formula for one of the standard designs (systematic, multistage, cluster, stratified) following the lecture slides.
Colonna di output con l'assegnazione di: Output column with each observation's cluster assignment.
Come allocare le unità di secondo stadio: How to allocate second-stage units. 'fixed': draws b units from each selected PSU. 'frac': draws a fraction f_b of each PSU's size. 'all': takes every unit in the selected PSUs (equivalent to cluster sampling).
Componente da visualizzare sull'asse ori: Component shown on the horizontal axis of the correlation circle and biplot (e.g., 1 = PC1).
Componente da visualizzare sull'asse ver: Component shown on the vertical axis of the correlation circle and biplot (e.g., 2 = PC2).
Criterio di agglomerazione passato a sta: Agglomeration criterion passed to stats::hclust. Ward (ward.D2) is the most common choice for standardised quantitative data.
Default TRUE: il CPV \"classico\" è con: Default TRUE: "classical" PPS uses with-replacement sampling because the estimator formulae simplify. If FALSE applies sample() without replacement with weight-proportional probabilities (approximate πps).
Descrizione della variabile quantitativa: Description of the quantitative variable via categories
Descrizione di ciascun 'Cluster' tramite: Description of each 'Cluster' via quantitative variables
Dimensione N della popolazione di riferi: Reference population size N. Used for the (1 - f) finite-population correction in without-replacement sampling.
Formula analitica per piano specifico: Analytical formula for a specific plan
Frazione f = n/N della popolazione da es: Sampling fraction f = n/N of the population (e.g., 0.1 = 10%).
Sampling fraction f = n/N of the population.
Frazione f_g = n_g / M dei grappoli da e: Fraction f_g = n_g / M of clusters to draw.
Indica se il campione è definito tramite: Whether the sample is specified by an absolute number of units (n) or by a fraction f = n/N of the population.
Whether the sample is specified by an absolute number of units (n) or by a fraction f of the population.
Indica se si specifica un numero assolut: Whether to specify an absolute number of clusters to draw or a fraction of all clusters.
Mappa di posizionamento (variabili e bar: Positioning map (variables and centroids, no observations)
Margine di errore massimo ammesso, espre: Maximum admissible margin of error, on the parameter scale: for a proportion 0 < Δ < 1 (e.g., 0.03 = 3%); for a mean any positive value on the variable's scale (e.g., ±2 points).
Metrica di distanza fra osservazioni. 'e: Distance metric between observations. 'euclidean'/'manhattan'/'mahalanobis' for quantitative data; 'SokalMichener' and 'binary' (Jaccard) for binary 0/1 data; 'politomici' for polytomous categorical with integer levels; 'gower' for mixed-type datasets.
Modulo didattico e applicativo per il co: Educational and applied module for the Market Research course. It bundles tools for survey sampling (sample size, sample drawing under the main probability designs — simple random, systematic, proportional and optimal stratified, cluster, two-stage, probability-proportional-to-size — confidence intervals and Design Effect), for hierarchical cluster analysis (with metrics to choose the number of groups, cluster description, and partition comparison via the Adjusted Rand Index), and for principal component analysis (varimax/promax rotation, correlation circle, biplot and squared-cosines heatmap).
Nome della colonna che jamovi inietterà: Name of the column injected by jamovi into the dataset with each observation's cluster assignment.
Numero di cluster k a cui tagliare il de: Number of clusters k at which to cut the dendrogram to produce the observation-to-cluster assignment.
Numero di componenti principali da riten: Number of principal components to retain (maximum 5). To guide the choice, consult the eigenvalues table and the scree plot (Kaiser criterion: λ > 1; elbow rule; cumulative variance criterion).
Numero di grappoli (cluster) da estrarre: Number of clusters to draw from the population.
Numero massimo di osservazioni da mostra: Maximum number of observations to display
Numerosità n, letta in due modi: se è la: Sample size n, read in two ways: if it is the size of the simple random sample to be matched, the complex design needs n_complex = Deff · n units; if it is a sample already collected with the complex design, it is worth n_eff = n / Deff units of a simple random sample.
Size of the sample to draw.
Per una variabile categoriale, etichetta: For a categorical variable, label of the level treated as a "success" (numerator of the proportion). If empty, the first level is used.
Piano di campionamento per cui calcolare: Sampling design for which the theoretical Deff is computed.
Plot delle sole variabili: baricentri de: Variable-only plot: centroids of supplementary qualitative variable categories + (optionally) active and/or supplementary quantitative arrows. Useful for reading the positioning of segments or brands with respect to the attributes.
R² tra variabile di interesse e di strat: R² between target and stratification variable
Rotazione applicata ai loadings per faci: Rotation applied to the loadings to ease component interpretation. Varimax (orthogonal) maximises the variance of squared loadings on each component; Promax (oblique) allows the rotated components to be correlated.
Scarto quadratico medio σ della variabil: Standard deviation σ of the variable of interest in the population (required for the "mean" case).
Se fornita, l'IC include il fattore corr: When provided, the CI includes the finite-population correction (1 - f). Keep N very large (or ignore) for the "infinite population" case.
Se specificata, l'IC viene calcolato dir: When specified, the CI is computed directly from this variable's data (mean if numeric, proportion of the reference level if a binary factor).
Se specificata, le unità della popolazio: When specified, units are sorted by this variable before applying the sampling step. Systematic-sampling efficiency depends critically on the ordering.
Se TRUE aggiunge le frecce delle variabi: If TRUE, adds the active variable arrows to the map.
If TRUE, adds the supplementary quantitative arrows (if any) to the map.
Se TRUE applica (1 - f) all'espressione: If TRUE, applies (1 - f) to the estimator's variance expression.
Se TRUE applica la formula per popolazio: If TRUE, applies the infinite-population / with-replacement formula (SRS-WR); if FALSE, applies the (1 - f) finite-population correction (SRS-WOR).
Se TRUE applica la PCA sulla matrice di: If TRUE, applies PCA on the correlation matrix (prior z-score). Recommended when variables have different units or variances. If FALSE, applies PCA on the covariance matrix.
Se TRUE estrazione con reinserimento (SC: If TRUE, sampling with replacement (SRS-WR): the same unit may be drawn multiple times. If FALSE, sampling without replacement (SRS-WOR).
Se TRUE mostra il pannello con la descri: If TRUE, shows the panel with the methodological description of the analysis.
If TRUE, shows the panel with the methodological description.
Se TRUE produce il dendrogramma colorato: If TRUE, produces the cluster-coloured dendrogram.
Se TRUE produce il grafico del Delta G (: If TRUE, produces the Delta G plot (differences between successive merge heights) as k varies.
Se TRUE produce il grafico dell'Indice F: If TRUE, produces the Calinski-Harabasz F-index plot as k varies.
Se TRUE produce il grafico dell'R² al va: If TRUE, produces the R² plot as k varies.
Se TRUE produce il grafico dell'RMSSTD a: If TRUE, produces the RMSSTD plot as k varies.
Se TRUE standardizza le variabili prima: If TRUE, standardises variables before computing distances. Applied only to numeric distances (Euclidean, Manhattan, Mahalanobis); ignored for binary/categorical distances.
Seme del generatore casuale, usato per s: Random-number generator seed, used to pick the starting point t in 1..k. Ensures sample reproducibility.
Seme del generatore casuale. Impostare u: Random-number generator seed. Setting a value ensures exact reproducibility of the sample.
Soglia di significatività in percentuale: Significance threshold as a percentage (default 5 = 0.05) used to filter variables and categories reported in the results.
Solo per la modalità manuale (senza vari: Only for the manual mode (no variable selected).
Spuntare per iniettare nel dataset la co: Tick to inject into the dataset the column with each unit's draw frequency (0 = not drawn; 1 = drawn once; >1 only under with-replacement). Column name will be freq_SSR or freq_SCR depending on the scheme.
Tick to inject into the dataset the column with each unit's draw frequency. Column name will be freq_CPV.
Tick to inject the sample-indicator column into the dataset: 1 if the unit was drawn, 0 otherwise. Column name will be in_SM (Systematic).
Tick to inject the sample-indicator column into the dataset. Column name will be in_2STG.
Tick to inject the sample-indicator column into the dataset. Column name will be in_GR.
Tick to inject the sample-indicator column into the dataset. Column name will be in_STpr or in_STott depending on the chosen method.
Tipo di parametro che l'indagine intende: Type of parameter the survey aims to estimate. Determines the formula used to compute the sample size.
Una o più variabili categoriali (o numer: One or more categorical variables (or numeric with few levels) used to split the population into M strata. If more than one is provided, strata are the joint cross of the levels (e.g., Sex × Age band → 6 strata for 2 × 3 levels). Units within each stratum should be homogeneous with respect to the variable of interest.
Una o più variabili categoriali suppleme: One or more supplementary categorical variables. The centroids of their categories are projected on the principal plane and drawn in the "Positioning map" plot.
Unità per gruppo / dimensione grappolo (: Units per group / cluster size (n_s or n_g)
Valore di P utilizzato nella formula. Se: Value of P used in the formula. If no pilot estimate is available, leave 0.5 (maximum variance, giving an upward estimate of n).
Variabile categoriale (tipicamente l'ass: Categorical variable (typically the cluster assignment) to be described. If numeric, condes is used; if factor, catdes is used.
Variabile categoriale che NON contribuis: Categorical variable that does NOT contribute to component computation. Used ONLY to colour observations on the biplot.
Variable identifying the clusters (e.g., city, school, neighbourhood). Units within the same cluster should be heterogeneous with respect to the variable of interest: the method is efficient when clusters are "small populations" similar to each other.
Variabile che identifica le unità primar: Variable identifying the primary sampling units (PSUs): typically cities, schools or neighbourhoods. The first stage randomly draws n_g PSUs.
Variabile quantitativa positiva proporzi: Positive quantitative variable proportional to each unit's "weight" in the population (e.g., turnover, employees, inhabitants). Inclusion probabilities p_i are computed as w_i / Σ w_i.
Variabile quantitativa usata per stimare: Quantitative variable used to estimate the standard deviation σ_j within each stratum (required for the optimal method). Typically the variable of interest or a proxy.
Variabile usata per etichettare le osser: Variable used to label observations in the tables and biplot.
Variabile usata per identificare le sing: Variable used to identify the individual units in the dataset. When specified, the "Sampled units" table shows the IDs of the selected subjects.
Variable used to identify the individual units in the dataset. When specified, the "Sampled units" table shows the IDs of the selected subjects. It does not affect the sampling process.
Variable used to identify the individual units in the dataset. When specified, the "Sampled units" table shows the IDs and weights of the selected subjects.
Variabile usata per identificare le unit: Variable used to identify second-stage units (SSUs). When specified, the "Sampled units" table shows the IDs of the selected subjects.
Variabili (almeno due) che codificano pa: Variables (at least two) coding alternative partitions of the same observations. The Adjusted Rand Index is computed for each pair.
Variabili (quantitative e/o qualitative): Variables (quantitative and/or qualitative) used to describe the target variable through statistical tests.
Variabili numeriche su cui calcolare la: Numeric variables on which to compute the distance matrix and apply the hierarchical clustering algorithm.
Variabili quantitative che NON contribui: Quantitative variables that do NOT contribute to component computation but are projected a posteriori on the principal plane. Useful to validate components against external variables.
Variabili quantitative usate per costrui: Quantitative variables used to build the principal components. At least two are required. PCA operates on the covariance matrix (if not standardised) or the correlation matrix (if standardised).
Numerosità efficace di n unità raccolte: Effective size of n units collected with the design
